statement: AI spending is reported to be extremely concentrated: the top 10% of AI firms account for 99.5% of model-serving spend, and two-thirds of current AI revenue comes from Anthropic and OpenAI.
why: If nearly all serving spend and most AI revenue sit with a handful of labs, accelerator demand inherits their funding and roadmap risk rather than being broadly diversified.

impact.mechanism: Concentrated end-customer spend means a pullback at one or two labs removes a large share of inference and training demand at once.

evidence.excerpt: the top 10% of AI firms account for '99.5%' of model-serving spend

confidence.basis: Attributed in the document to analyst commentary inside an aggregation, with no primary dataset or filing named.

entity: hyperscalers (Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Oracle, Meta); Goldman Sachs
